title: Shinonome Akito — Profile Story

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really want us to practice talking with the crowd...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In my mind, this isn't something you can practice. You gotta see how they're feeling in the moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, it's a necessary part of making an event exciting... I'll give it everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm Akito Shinonome from Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You probably already know since you're here, but we only have one goal. To surpass that legendary event, RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why we're a team. That's why we're singing. Our performance will show you how serious we are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I decided to start singing because of what I saw that night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I couldn't really sing at first, which led to a lot of frustrating moments.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was able to come this far because of my team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My life won't feel complete until I surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And we all feel that way...
We're all going after the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All of us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, watch us...
We're never going to disappoint you again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna make the next legend happen.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, how's that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Based on your expressions, I guess I did just fine...
